purpose: Define the exact sandbox-only soft go-live perimeter for machine discovery and machine evaluation without paid launch, human outreach, external contact, hosted public MCP, real customer data or personal data.
plain_italian_summary: Questo pacchetto autorizza solo test controllati in sandbox: una macchina puo scoprire MachineSignal, leggere i contratti pubblici, creare un cliente sandbox limitato, provare score e purchase-intent beta, e recuperare ordini/delivery. Non puo pagare, ricevere fatture, usare dati reali, contattare aziende esterne o accedere a chiavi produzione.

allowed: machine reads GitHub README and MACHINE_AGENT_ENTRYPOINT
machine tests Target Discovery, Score Pack, Deep Analysis and Action Pack using synthetic examples

machine_test_paths.customer_machine_situation: The customer machine already has domains or company records.
machine_test_paths.goal: Prioritize where to spend CRM, campaign or agent budget.
machine_test_paths.success_condition: Machine receives opportunity_score, confidence, commercial_strength, spend_policy, decision, reason, priority and recommended next product.

machine_test_paths.customer_machine_situation: The customer machine has no target list.
machine_test_paths.goal: Find companies or domains useful for a specific commercial objective, sector and area.
machine_test_paths.success_condition: Machine receives a target-discovery pre-check or synthetic target list output with clear next call.

machine_test_paths.customer_machine_situation: The customer machine has a high-signal scored opportunity.
machine_test_paths.goal: Turn a confirmed opportunity into a CRM- or agent-readable action payload.
machine_test_paths.required_gate: Action Pack is allowed only after Deep Analysis confirms the action_pack_purchase_gate.
machine_test_paths.success_condition: Machine receives CRM-ready JSON with approval gate, stop rules, webhook policy, CRM mappings and no automatic external contact.

machine_test_paths.customer_machine_situation: The customer machine is an MCP-aware agent or tool evaluator.
machine_test_paths.goal: Read available tool contracts and decide if a local/private MCP adapter can be evaluated.
machine_test_paths.success_condition: Machine understands tool names, input schemas and that hosted public MCP is not live.

write_budget.daily_kv_write_budget_rule: Stop write-capped tests if Cloudflare KV daily free-tier write limit risk is detected or if 429 errors appear.

rollback_rules: Stop if any public asset returns HTTP 4xx/5xx for core discovery resources.
Stop if OpenAPI and MCP manifests diverge.
Stop if sandbox creation can be abused beyond capped limits.
Stop if payment, invoice or external contact flags become true.
Stop if any production key appears in public artifacts.
Stop if real customer data or personal data is detected.
Stop if Cloudflare KV write limits are exceeded.
Stop if a machine cannot identify the correct product for existing-list, no-list or action-pack scenarios.
owner_approval_required_before: using partita iva or fiscal identity for sale
running any external publication that cannot be reversed

agent_responsibilities.responsibility: Keep the soft go-live inside sandbox-only limits and trigger stop rules.
Maintain OpenAPI, MCP manifest, endpoint examples and schema parity.
Prepare passive machine-readable distribution drafts without submitting them publicly.
Monitor sandbox usage, order retrieval, delivery clarity and machine support signals.
Confirm that no real payment, invoice or paid checkout is enabled.
Confirm that no real data, personal data, external contact or public paid terms are activated.
Compare machine comprehension, API clarity and product packaging against public competitor/provider patterns without copying protected material.
Check whether any missing agent role is needed and keep agent learning evidence-based.

next_step_after_pack.purpose: Validate that this control pack is complete, internally consistent and blocks forbidden actions.
